name: jlc-hardware-learning
description: The ZhiYuanEDA hardware-learning canvas for selection-scoped schematic questions, official EasyEDA visual evidence, teaching annotations, and local exports.

interface.shortDescription: Learn from official EasyEDA schematic visual evidence.
interface.longDescription: A dedicated JLC SVG hardware-learning canvas for framing schematic regions, asking questions in the normal Codex conversation, adding teaching annotations, importing identity-verified EasyEDA PNG or locally rendered PDF evidence, switching canvas pages, and exporting PNG, SVG, or JSON files. The canvas keeps project-local state, protects imported schematic evidence, supports render-safe zoom and viewport image culling, and disables generation, telemetry, and direct EasyEDA writes.
capabilities: Official EasyEDA PNG and PDF-derived visual import
Local PNG, SVG, and JSON export
defaultPrompt: 打开 JLC 硬件学习画板并解析我框选的原理图区域。
解释当前学习框里的器件和信号路径。
检查当前学习框的硬件风险并添加教学标注。
